newsitem.title: USA: LodgeNet issues $150 mln senior notes.
newsitem.headline: LodgeNet issues $150 mln senior notes.

text.p: LodgeNet Entertainment Corp said Thursday it issued $150 million principal amount of its 10.25 percent senior notes due 2006.

It also entered into a secured bank credit facility providing for up to $100 million in revolving advances. Proceeds from the notes were used to repay about $50 million of outstanding debt, the company said.

The rest of the proceeds will be used to finance expansion of the company's business of providing video on-demand, network based video games, cable television programming and other interactive entertainment and information services to the lodging and multi-family residential markets.
LodgeNet said the notes were offered through Morgan Stanley & Co, NatWest Capital Markets Ltd and Montgomery Securities acting as placement agents.
The credit facility with National Westminster Bank plc provides total lending commitments of $100 million.
